title: Pollinations meets OpenClaw
summary:
OpenClaw got a path to Pollinations models, while the community showcase made room for another gateway.

A team-built OpenClaw integration added a setup page and script for configuring Pollinations as an OpenAI-compatible model provider. The configuration offers eight selectable models, with Kimi K2.5 as the default and DeepSeek V3.2 and GLM-4.7 as fallbacks.

The setup page now walks through installation, API key connection, and configuration in order. The script prints the appropriate installation or onboarding command rather than running it for you. The Builders Night page also gained clearer branding and a mobile-friendly header.

The app catalog added @MatheusHMafra’s NebulaAPI, a free Brazilian API gateway for AI and gaming that uses Pollinations as a backend.

highlights.title: Pollinations for OpenClaw
highlights.text: Configure Pollinations as an OpenClaw model provider with a setup script and choose from eight models. Kimi K2.5 is the default, with DeepSeek V3.2 and GLM-4.7 as fallbacks.
